states.ready: Exact M3 preflight permits execution and query planning is complete.
states.needs_user_evidence: Supported analysis requires source-bound evidence through Phase 8B controls.
states.needs_mapping_review: Supported analysis requires a physical-column mapping decision.
states.blocked_safety: Canonical safety, grain, relationship or aggregation policy prevents execution.
states.unsupported_mvp: Recognized concept has no supported current-MVP decision capability.
states.stale: Artifact, overlay, source or handoff identity was superseded.
states.executing: Governed runtime execution is in progress.
states.execution_failed: M3 passed but governed execution failed.
